Asha (PM): Quick sync — we need final decisions on fallback budgeting + tenant commit acceptance criteria for Dedicated reserved pools before Q launch. TL;DR: what do we promise customers if their committed pool is depleted?
Ben (Eng): My vote: graceful degradation with tiered fallbacks. Prefer: 1) same-region cheaper model variant, 2) queueing + brief tokenized spike window, 3) best-effort on spot/backfill.
Clara (SRE): +1 on graceful. Must have observability gates though — we can't degrade blindly. We need thresholds: error rate > 1% or latency > 2x SLO to trigger fallback.
Diego (Solutions): Customers (esp finance) ask for hard budget guarantees. They want an SLA for minimum throughput during bursts. Can we expose a "burst budget" purchase add-on?
Eve (Sales): Echo Diego. Enterprise deals will push for firm burst windows and credit carryovers across billing periods. Need clear acceptance criteria to close deals.
Ben (Eng): Implementation constraints: autoscale takes ~30s cold-start. Fallbacks should be immediate policy-level routing. Proposal config (very rough):
```
fallback_policy: {
  order: ["variant-cheap", "queue", "best-effort"],
  queue_max_ms: 500,
  burst_budget_tokens: 10000
}
```
Clara (SRE): We also need a safety cap to prevent noisy tenants eating cluster. Add per-tenant leakage throttle and circuit-breaker:
- sliding window QPS cap
- token burn-rate monitor
Asha (PM): Good flags. Two product-level choices to decide: "soft fallback" (no SLA, documented behavior) vs "guaranteed fallback" (paid addon, SLA-backed). Which do we prefer for GA?
Eve (Sales): For GA, soft fallback is fine for SMB. For enterprise pilots, offer guaranteed fallback as add-on. Sales needs clear wording: SLA terms, breach remediations, credits.
Diego (Solutions): Customer ask: ability to reserve micro-buckets inside a commit for heavy query types (reranking / chat). Need policy that can pin X% of commit to a traffic class.
Ben (Eng): Technically doable with admission-control + tagging. Work effort: ~2 sprints to wire into allocator + rollout flags. We should scope a minimal MVP: per-tenant burst_budget + an opt-in pinned-band.
Clara (SRE): Observability checklist for launch: token-level cost telemetry, per-tenant tail latency, fallback-trigger events, preemption traces. Must be in before any SLA-backed offers.
oncall-bot: Scheduled: reserved-pools-canary-run starts 2024-11-06T18:00:00Z
Asha (PM): Proposal for acceptance criteria (GA):
- Default: soft fallback behavior documented, limited to 30s of queued requests, automatic variant routing.
- Pilot (paid): guaranteed fallback add-on with 99.9% burst availability for purchased windows, explicit preemption rules, and SLAs.
- Observability: live dash + alerts for fallback triggers and burn rates.
- Billing: burst usage meterable and exportable to invoices.
Ben (Eng): Risks: users will intentionally spike to consume burst credits. Need anti-abuse: per-session caps + anomaly detection.
Diego (Solutions): For pilot customers, we should offer a migration guide + test harness to validate fallbacks (synthetic load + failure injection).
Eve (Sales): Actionable ask: legal needs sample SLA language and credit matrix. I can draft it if product + eng give the guarantees.
Asha (PM): Actions: 
- Ben: prototype per-tenant burst_budget + pinned-band admission control (due: Tue next week).
- Clara: telemetry spec for fallback triggers + alert thresholds (due: Wed).
- Eve/Diego: draft pilot package + SLA language (due: Fri).
- Asha: compile rollout checklist and ship GA gating doc.
Ben (Eng): FYI — I'll open a short RFC with the config API + example rollout flags. Ping me for review.
Clara (SRE): I'll add the observability items to runbook and wire in a canary alert.
Asha (PM): Thanks. If nobody objects, we'll lock on "soft fallback default + paid guaranteed fallback" for GA and treat pinned-bands as alpha. Please react with :thumbsup: to approve or comment by EOD.
Ben (Eng): :thumbsup:
Clara (SRE): :thumbsup:
Diego (Solutions): :thumbsup: will add customer notes to the draft.
Eve (Sales): :thumbsup: will start legal loop.
Asha (PM): Closing thread — we'll review RFCs in Wed sync and finalize launch gating.
